title: Ocean food web cards
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Habitats and blocking sound (Blue Abyss and Can We Block Sound?)
source: Seeded from science/y4 lesson 30 (Ocean food web cards (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 30: Ocean food webs and what happens when one link is lost. To understand how changes to one animal in a food web affect the others

cards:
food web

together

live in a place

catching fish faster than they
can breed
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.q: Krill → penguin → leopard seal. What happens to penguins if krill are overfished?
questions.a: Penguin numbers fall: they lose their food
questions.model: Follow the arrow from krill: krill feed penguins. Less krill means less food for penguins. So penguin numbers fall.

questions.q: Give one way to stop overfishing.
questions.a: For example: catch limits or protecting young fish

questions.q: Build a food web from 6 ocean cards. Then answer: what happens if the small fish are all caught?
questions.a: A web with producers at the bottom; seals and birds go hungry; plankton increase
questions.model: Teacher places plankton at the bottom and joins the first two arrows.

questions.q: Write two sentences on why overfishing harms more than just the fish caught.
questions.a: Animals that eat those fish lose food; the balance of the web changes

questions.q: Why might a food web cope better than a single chain if one animal disappears?
questions.a: Animals in a web have other foods to switch to

questions.q: Many food chains joined together make a...
Big question: what happens to seals if the small fish are all caught?
questions.a: Seals lose food and their numbers fall.
